reason: I might download the free version to see if the bank sync actually works, but I wouldn't pay for Pro. Every auto-tracker I've tried has missed or doubled up UPI payments, and a brand new app from one developer with zero reviews isn't going to get my bank linked straight away, let alone Rs 99 a month.
objection: Auto-sync gets my transactions wrong and I spend more time fixing it than I would just updating my sheet. And I'm not sure about linking my bank account to an unknown solo developer's app.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or colleague showing me a month where it caught all their UPI spends without duplicates, plus some proof the data is safe, like reviews or a clear privacy policy.
